fields.summary: Prusa i3 — это семейство FFF-принтеров, производимых чешской компанией Prusa Research под торговой маркой Original Prusa i3. Благодаря низкой стоимости и простоте сборки, эти принтеры стали популярными среди любителей, профессионалов и в образовательных целях.

evidence.bed_surface: Other new features include a polyetherimide print surface
evidence.screen_type: This model features a new version of their "Nextruder" extruder system first seen on the Prusa XL, no-adjustment load cell bed leveling, a modular replaceable all-metal hot end, a color touchscreen
evidence.firmware: All Original Prusa products use Marlin 3D printing firmware.
evidence.summary: The Prusa i3 is a family of fused filament fabrication 3D printers, manufactured by Czech company Prusa Research under the trademarked name Original Prusa i3.
evidence.unique_features: The i3 series is released under an open source license
evidence.target_use: made it popular in education and with hobbyists and professionals
evidence.kinematics: A Cartesian mechanism permits placement of material anywhere in a cubic volume; this design has continued throughout development of the i3 series.
evidence.filament_diameter_mm: he introduced the new i3 1.75 mm version in August 2015.
evidence.voltage_v: Electrical components were updated to work with the new 24 volt power supply.
evidence.nozzle_hardened: This model features a new version of their "Nextruder" extruder system first seen on the Prusa XL, no-adjustment load cell bed leveling, a modular replaceable all-metal hot end
evidence.heated_bed: He adapted and simplified the RepRap Mendel design, reducing the time to print 3D plastic parts from 20 to 10 hours, changing to the use of two Z-axis motors to simplify the frame, and including 3D printed bushings in place of regular bearings. First announced in September 2010, the printer was dubbed Prusa Mendel by Průša himself.
evidence.multimaterial_supported: In February 2019, Prusa i3 MK3S was released, along with the Multi Material Upgrade 2S (MMU2S), which allows selecting any of 5 different materials for printing together automatically.
evidence.filament_runout_sensor: Ease-of-use features included a filament detector, allowing the printer to load filament when it is inserted, and to pause printing if the filament is jammed or runs out
evidence.power_loss_recovery: Ease-of-use features included ... recovery after power outages.
evidence.release_year: released as a commercial kit product in 2015
